steps.title: Determine magnetic height
steps.instruction: Measure and set the magnetic engagement height on the magnetic module, adjusting as needed because the plate is not in the labware library.

steps.title: Set reagent volume scheme
steps.instruction: If a reagent occupies more than one column in the reagent plate (e.g., BWB), allocate the reagent volume per sample; otherwise allocate the volume per protocol.

steps.title: Configure protocol pauses
steps.instruction: Enable pauses for user intervention as described in the SOP; the system will automatically pause for tip depletion and prompt the user to refill tips.

steps.title: Run SOP sections 1‑2
steps.instruction: Execute sections 1 and 2 of the Illumina TruSeq Stranded mRNA SOP, which cover purification of mRNA through to the end of the Fragment mRNA step.
